DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_GrassMammoth_Ice:
Can be ridden.
While mounted, increases logging efficiency by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> and mining efficiency by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</>.
While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Freeze by <Status_Up>{Passive3_EffectValue4}%</> and increases own Health by <Status_Up>{Passive3_EffectValue3}%</> and Attack and Defense by <Status_Up>{Passive3_EffectValue1}%</>.
(Does not stack)
